syntax.passing_assertion: Every planned .ts unit reaches indexed, parse_error or excluded with exact spans.
syntax.failure_rule: Any unit vanishes or syntax error becomes empty success.

imports.passing_assertion: Value and type-only imports retain targets and kind.
imports.failure_rule: Type-only import counted as runtime value edge fails.

exports.passing_assertion: Alias and type re-exports match exactly.
exports.failure_rule: Re-export omission or all declarations exported fails.

names.passing_assertion: Three same functions retain distinct scope ids.

calls.passing_assertion: Typed direct call resolves while any/missing/external retain distinct status.
calls.failure_rule: Any receiver promoted or missing call omitted fails.
calls.rationale: Compiler-backed conditions are required for resolved tier.

types.passing_assertion: Interface, type import, implements and return facts match.
types.failure_rule: Syntax-only backend advertised as resolved fails.

frameworks.failure_rule: Generic TypeScript success promoted to framework support fails.

incremental.passing_assertion: Mutation forces stale/full rebuild and never claims incremental.
incremental.failure_rule: Silent stale reuse or incremental advertisement fails.
